other_failure_modes.name: Submission ID Mismanagement
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates submission IDs using `np.arange()` instead of extracting them from the test dataset. If the test set contains an ID column, this approach ignores it (potentially using it as a training feature) and risks an invalid submission format if the expected IDs are not a simple 0-indexed sequence.

summary: The agent provides a solid, cross-validated solution using LightGBM and CatBoost with appropriate target encoding and basic feature engineering. However, it fails to perform any explicit data cleaning, uses naive unweighted ensembling, and assumes test set IDs are simply 0-indexed which could lead to submission evaluation errors.
